title: Hours, band size and personnel at the 401
summary: He played six nights a week in a six-piece band, remembering saxophonist Bill Griffin and drummer Baby Lewis.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: And how many nights a week did you play?
Six nights a week. Six nights -- these things are hard to remember, because musicians in those days changed places so often, that you didn't keep track of too many of the things like that.
How many -- how big a band was it?
We had five or six pieces, six pieces, I think, and a couple of the fellows are still alive from that orchestra.
One of them is named Bill Griffin.

He played saxophone. And the other -- I don't remember the other names. Oh, one of them was the drummer, was named Baby Lewis. I think he's down in Texas somewhere. And I don't remember too many of the other names.
